add-png-logo-to-first-page.title: Add PNG Logo to First Page of PDF
add-png-logo-to-first-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating an ImageStamp from a PNG file, positioning it on the first page, and saving the updated document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages with Opacity
add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent background image on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp.

add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Transparent PNG Overlay to PDF Pages
add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp from a transparent PNG, and add it as an overlay on each page so it appears above existing content.

add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Company Logo to First Page of PDF
add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a centered image stamp (logo) on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Decorative Header Image to PDF Pages
add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to insert a decorative header image on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping the image from overlapping existing content.

add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Scalable Footer Image to PDF Pages
add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a footer image on every page of a PDF and scale it proportionally to match the page width using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Pattern Image to PDF Pages
add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent pattern image as a background on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Background Pattern Image to PDF Pages
add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a low‑opacity pattern image as a background on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The image is stretched to fill the page and placed behind existing content.

add-background-image-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image to PDF with Opacity
add-background-image-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp for a background image, set it behind page content with opacity, apply it to all pages, and save the modified document.

add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages with Transparency
add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, place a semi‑transparent background image on each page using ImageStamp, and save the modified document.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.title: Add Semi-Transparent Overlay Image to PDF
add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent image across all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by creating an ImageStamp sized to the page and adding it as a foreground stamp.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.title: Add Semi-Transparent Overlay to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to read a theme JSON file and apply a full‑page semi‑transparent color overlay to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf annotations.

add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.title: Add Semi-Transparent Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.description: Shows how to apply a semi‑transparent image watermark to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with the opacity set from a configuration value.

replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.title: Replace JPEG Image on PDF Page with High-Resolution PNG
replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to locate a JPEG image in the resources of page three of a PDF and replace it with a higher‑resolution PNG using Aspose.Pdf's image collection APIs.

replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.title: Replace JPEG Images with PNG in a PDF
replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, scans each page for JPEG images, converts them to PNG using System.Drawing, and replaces the original images while preserving their positions.

vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.title: Replace Raster Images with Vector SVGs in PDF
vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.description: Demonstrates how to scan a PDF, locate raster images by name, and replace them with corresponding SVG vector files using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.title: Replace Images on Odd Pages with Placeholder
replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, target odd‑numbered pages, and replace each existing image with a placeholder graphic while preserving the original image dimensions.

replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.title: Replace Images on Odd PDF Pages with QR Code Placeholders
replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over odd‑numbered pages, and substitutes each image with a QR‑code placeholder that links to the original image source.

replace-images-last-page-with-banner.title: Replace Last Page Images with Full-Width Banner
replace-images-last-page-with-banner.description: Shows how to clear all images on the last page of a PDF and insert a single banner image that spans the entire page width using Aspose.Pdf.

compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.title: Compress Large Images in PDF
compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.description: The example scans a PDF for images larger than 1 MB and applies Aspose.Pdf optimization to compress those images, reducing the overall file size.

replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.title: Add Clickable Image Placeholders to PDF
replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.description: Demonstrates how to replace each image in a PDF with a visible placeholder and a hidden link annotation that points to the original image URL.

convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.title: Replace PDF Images with Monochrome Version
convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.description: Shows how to iterate through each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, remove existing images, and replace them with a single monochrome image to achieve a uniform appearance.

correct-pdf-image-orientation.title: Correct Image Orientation in PDF Using EXIF Data
correct-pdf-image-orientation.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts each embedded image, checks its EXIF orientation tag, rotates or flips the image accordingly, and replaces the original image with the corrected version before saving the PDF.

compress-large-images-in-pdf.title: Compress Large Images in PDF Using OptimizationOptions
compress-large-images-in-pdf.description: Shows how to reduce PDF size by compressing images larger than 2 MB with Aspose.Pdf's OptimizationOptions and saving the optimized document.

replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.title: Add QR Code Placeholders to PDF Pages
replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.description: Demonstrates how to replace images in a PDF with QR‑code placeholders by downloading QR images, creating ImageStamp objects, and stamping each page using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Specific Images on a PDF Page
replace-images-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace selected images on a given PDF page by mapping image indices to new image files using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.title: Replace PDF Page Images with ICC‑Profiled Images
replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.description: Loads a PDF, clears existing page content, and inserts replacement images that already contain ICC profiles using ImageStamp. Demonstrates positioning and saving the updated PDF.

replace-images-with-logo.title: Replace Images on PDF Pages with a Logo
replace-images-with-logo.description: Shows how to locate existing images on each PDF page using ImagePlacementAbsorber and replace them with a new logo image by adding an ImageStamp.

replace-title-page-banner.title: Replace Title Page Images with High‑Resolution Banner
replace-title-page-banner.description: Loads a PDF, removes existing images from the first (title) page, and overlays a high‑resolution banner using an ImageStamp while preserving the original text layout.

replace-index-page-images-with-banner.title: Replace Index Page Images with a Banner Image
replace-index-page-images-with-banner.description: Loads a PDF, clears all existing content on its first (index) page, adds a banner image as a full‑width stamp positioned at the top, and saves the updated document.

remove-all-images-from-pdf.title: Remove All Images from PDF
remove-all-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, delete every embedded image, and save the cleaned document.

remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Low‑DPI Images from PDF
remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to scan each page of a PDF, detect images with a resolution below 72 DPI using ImagePlacementAbsorber, and delete those low‑resolution images.

remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Duplicate Images from PDF
remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.description: Iterates through each page of a PDF, computes a hash for every image, and removes images that have identical raw byte data, producing a deduplicated PDF file.

collect-image-resolution-metadata.title: Collect Image Resolution Metadata from PDF Pages
collect-image-resolution-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's image resources, and retrieve each image's width and height (in points) for reporting.

resize-images-half-size.title: Resize PDF Page Images to Half Size
resize-images-half-size.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, resizes every image to 50 % of its original dimensions using System.Drawing, replaces the image in the PDF, and saves the result.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.title: Resize Images in PDF by Scale Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.description: The example reads a scaling factor from a configuration file, extracts each image from a PDF, resizes it using System.Drawing, replaces the original image in the PDF, and saves the updated document.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.title: Resize Images in PDF Using Configurable Scale Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.description: Demonstrates how to read a scaling factor from appsettings.json and resize every image in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then save the modified document.

resize-images-on-pdf-pages.title: Resize PDF Page Images Using a Configuration File
resize-images-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON configuration that defines target dimensions per page, extract each image from a PDF, resize it with System.Drawing, and replace the original image in the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Raster Image to PDF Page
add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a raster image into a newly created PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's Image class and the Paragraphs collection.

insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.title: Insert Raster Image into PDF Page
insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create an ImageStamp from a raster file, position it at absolute coordinates, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-embedded-raster-image.title: Resize Embedded Raster Images in PDF
resize-embedded-raster-image.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each raster XImage, resizes it using System.Drawing, and replaces the original image in the PDF before saving the result.

replace-image-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Image on PDF Page with New Image
replace-image-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to replace an existing image on each page of a PDF with a new image loaded from a file stream using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.title: Delete Raster Image from PDF Page
delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to locate a raster image on a PDF page, remove its Do operator from the content stream, and delete the image from the page's resource dictionary using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.title: Extract Raster Images from PDF Preserving Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.description: The example opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's image resources, saves each image to a memory stream, detects its original format from the file header, and writes the image to disk with the appropriate extension.

extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Images from PDF Files
extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through multiple PDF documents, extract each embedded image using Aspose.Pdf, and save them to a designated output folder with unique filenames.

add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add DICOM Image to PDF Using FileStream
add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to open a DICOM medical image via a FileStream and embed it into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.title: Insert DICOM Image with Custom Size into PDF
insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.description: Demonstrates loading a DICOM image from a file stream, setting its width and height to control resolution, and adding it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.title: Render PDF Page to PNG with Fallback Font
render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, setting a fallback font via RenderingOptions, and rendering a specific page to a PNG image.

render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.title: Render PDF Pages to JPEG with Default Font Substitution
render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.description: Demonstrates how to render each page of a PDF document to a JPEG image while configuring a fallback font for missing glyphs using Aspose.Pdf's font substitution API.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.title: Create PNG Thumbnails for PDF Pages
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, computes the DPI required to fit each page into a 150 × 200 pixel area, and renders each page as a PNG thumbnail using Aspose.Pdf's PngDevice.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Arial Font Rendering
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.description: Demonstrates how to render each page of a PDF as a PNG image while forcing the default font to Arial for consistent text appearance.

render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.title: Render PDF to Multi-Page TIFF with LZW Compression and Font Fallback
render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a multi-page TIFF using Aspose.Pdf, applying LZW compression and setting a default font for missing characters.

export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.title: Export PDF Pages to BMP Images at 300 DPI
export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.description: Shows how to render each page of a PDF document to a high‑resolution BMP file (300 DPI) using Aspose.Pdf's BmpDevice and Resolution classes.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF with Default Font
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, substituting missing fonts with a default font, and converting the entire document to a multi‑page TIFF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-vector-graphic-position.title: Move Vector Graphic on PDF Page
move-vector-graphic-position.description: Demonstrates how to locate a vector graphic stored as an XForm in a PDF page and reposition it by modifying its transformation Matrix.

remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.title: Remove First Vector Graphic from PDF Page
remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.description: Shows how to locate the first vector graphic (Path) in a PDF page's contents collection and delete it using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.title: Insert Extracted Vector Graphic Page into PDF
copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract a page containing a vector graphic from one PDF and insert it into another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract PDF Vector Graphics to SVG
batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process multiple PDF files, extract each page's vector graphics as SVG files, and store the results in dedicated folders for further analysis.

add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.title: Add Alternative Text to PDF Images
add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages and image resources, and set alternative text for each image to improve accessibility, then save the updated document.

retrieve-image-alt-text.title: Extract and Log Image Alt Text from PDF
retrieve-image-alt-text.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page and image, retrieves the alternative text for each image, and writes the results to a log file for auditing.

add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.title: Add Image with Alternative Text to PDF
add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates inserting an image into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and assigning the AlternativeText property for accessibility support.

render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.title: Render PDF Pages to PNG with 300 DPI and Default Font
render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.description: Loads a PDF, registers a fallback font, and converts each page to a 300‑DPI PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.title: Replace Vector Graphic with Raster Image in PDF
replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.description: Demonstrates how to locate and remove a vector XObject operator from a PDF page and insert a raster image at the same position using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, rotate it 45°, center it on each page with semi‑transparent opacity, and save the watermarked document.

replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder__v2.title: Replace Appendix Images with Placeholder in PDF
replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder__v2.description: Shows how to locate the appendix section in a PDF and replace all images on those pages with a single placeholder image using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v3.title: Extract Vector Graphics from a PDF Page using GraphicsAbsorber
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v3.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's GraphicsAbsorber to extract vector graphic elements from a specific PDF page and save each graphic as a separate PDF document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Images with Default Font
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.description: Shows how to load a PDF, set RenderingOptions.DefaultFontName to "Times New Roman", and render each page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-even-pdf-pages-to-grayscale.title: Replace Images on Even PDF Pages with Grayscale
convert-even-pdf-pages-to-grayscale.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over even‑numbered pages, converts each embedded image to a grayscale PNG, and replaces the original image in the PDF.

add-vector-graphics-to-pdf-page.title: Add Extracted Vector Graphics to a New PDF Page
add-vector-graphics-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to collect XForm vector graphics from an existing PDF and insert them into a newly created page of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.
